content.short: A competitive skill-based top-down shooter on Aptos featuring a "Kill to Earn" model and browser-based gameplay.
content.description:
Aptos Arena is a competitive, skill-based top-down shooter game on the Aptos blockchain that pioneered the "Kill to Earn" (K2E) model. In this fast-paced PvP environment, players pay a small "spawn fee" in APT and earn the entry fees of every opponent they eliminate. These rewards are paid directly to the player's wallet, creating a truly competitive and rewarding gaming experience.

The game is designed to be purely skill-based, eliminating "pay-to-win" mechanics and ensuring a level playing field. Playable directly in a web browser on both PC and mobile, Aptos Arena offers accessible, high-stakes action without the need for high-end hardware or NFT ownership.
content.meta: Aptos Arena is a "Kill to Earn" top-down shooter on the Aptos blockchain. Explore its skill-based PvP gameplay on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
